reasoning_content:
The installation guide instructs me to do the following:
1. Log in to registry.opencode.de using a personal access token
2. Set HF_TOKEN in .env
3. Start docker compose

Both the registry login (a GitLab personal access token from gitlab.opencode.de) and the Hugging Face token are required. I don't have these credentials. Let me check whether they're available in the environment (they might be in environment variables, or there might be a token file).

Let me check the environment variables and look for any tokens that might have been pre-prepared.

action.command: env | grep -iE 'token|hf|gitlab|registry|pass|user|auth' | sed 's/=.*/=<REDACTED-PRESENCE>/' ; echo "---"; ls -la ~ 2>/dev/null; ls -la /root 2>/dev/null; ls /etc/docker 2>/dev/null; cat /root/.docker/config.json 2>/dev/null; cat /root/.huggingface 2>/dev/null; ls -la /root/.cache 2>/dev/null

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "env | grep -iE 'token|hf|gitlab|registry|pass|user|auth' | sed 's/=.*/=<REDACTED-PRESENCE>/' ; echo \"---\"; ls -la ~ 2>/dev/null; ls -la /root 2>/dev/null; ls /etc/docker 2>/dev/null; cat /root/.docker/config.json 2>/dev/null; cat /root/.huggingface 2>/dev/null; ls -la /root/.cache 2>/dev/null", "security_risk": "UNKNOWN", "summary": "Check for pre-existing credentials in env and home"}

summary: Check for pre-existing credentials in env and home
